original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日尔军方称兵变后“逐步恢复控制”
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日尔军方表示，在首都尼亚美国际机场附近的军事基地发生兵变后，正在“逐步恢复控制”。据国防部长萨利富·莫迪将军在公共电视上宣读的声明，一群士兵违反军事规定，试图扣押战友并开枪，但国防与安全部队的迅速反应已控制局势。目前尚无伤亡或具体细节的独立确认。

key_facts.fact: 尼日尔军方称兵变后逐步恢复控制
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Niger's military on Saturday said it was "gradually regaining control" after mutineers started holding soldiers hostage at a military base next to the capital's airport and fired shots.

key_facts.fact: 兵变发生在尼亚美国际机场附近的军事基地
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a military base next to the capital's airport

key_facts.fact: 国防部长声明称士兵违反规定并开枪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a group of soldiers acting in breach of military regulations attempted to detain some of their comrades at the Base 101 barracks in Niamey and opened fire on several sensitive sites in the city

uncertainties: 兵变的具体细节和伤亡情况尚未独立确认
目前仅有一个来源（AfricaNews）报道此事，缺乏交叉验证
